title: find-files-by-schema match
description: One line of `find-files-by-schema --output=jsonl`: a repo file whose schema: URI resolves to a tcms-schemas type. Each stdout line is one JSON object of this shape. The verified and errors fields appear only with --verify.

path.description: File path relative to the scan root (--root), with '/' separators.

schema.description: Vendored schema file the file's schema: URI resolves to, relative to schemas/tcms-schemas/, for example tcms/test-run.schema.json.

type.description: Value of the document's top-level type: field, or null when the document has none.

verified.description: Present only with --verify: true when the document's content validates against its declared schema.

errors.description: Present only with --verify: one '<pointer>: <message>' per violation; empty when verified is true. The pointer is '(root)' for the document root.
